content.overview: Section 4 deals with a mediation agreement by which parties agree to submit present or future disputes to mediation.
content.glance: Section 4 deals with a mediation agreement by which parties agree to submit present or future disputes to mediation.
content.study: A mediation agreement may be a clause in a contract or a separate agreement. It records the parties' consent to resolve a present or future dispute by mediation under the Mediation Act, 2023.
